name: WoW Note
shortDescription: A fast, lightweight Myanmar-first notes app with Myanmar Calendar, custom fonts and private local tools.
description: WoW Note is a lightweight, instant-feeling notes app built for fast writing and comfortable Myanmar reading. Open existing notes in reader mode, edit only when you choose, create text notes or checklists, organize with colors and pins, search and sort quickly, add notes from a Myanmar Calendar, import your own fonts, tune font size and line height, lock private notes with a master PIN, set reminders, archive notes and keep local backups.

features.title: Fast local notes
features.text: SQLite-backed local notes, quick launch, responsive search and lightweight list rendering keep everyday writing fast.

features.title: Text notes & checklists
features.text: Create normal text notes or checklist-style notes and switch between the two when needed.

features.title: Myanmar Calendar
features.text: Browse Gregorian dates together with Myanmar calendar information and create or open notes directly from a selected date.

features.title: Reader-first workflow
features.text: Existing notes open in a clean read view first. Tap Edit only when you want to change the note, then save back to reading mode.

features.title: Comfortable typography
features.text: Adjust font size and line height, import a custom font and use Myanmar-safe font fallback for comfortable long-form reading.

features.title: ColorNote-style organization
features.text: Use note colors, pins, archive, search, sorting and List, Details, Grid or Large Grid views with a familiar bottom navigation flow.

features.title: Private notes
features.text: Protect selected notes with a master PIN and unlock them only when you need to read or edit them.

features.title: Useful note actions
features.text: Copy all, send/share, find text, set reminders, archive, delete and manage note colors from the note actions menu.

features.title: Backup & restore
features.text: Export and restore your local note collection from Settings, including organization and note metadata.

whatsNew: Fixed App Store Open so the installed app can be launched directly from the browser.
Added a browser-safe deep link entry point for WoW Note.
Kept the reader-first note workflow, Myanmar Calendar, custom fonts, private-note lock, reminders and backup tools from v1.0.2.

safety.title: Local-first and private
safety.text: Core note content is stored locally on your Android device. No account is required for normal note use. Sharing, reminders, backup/export and any external actions happen only when you choose them.
